title.rendered: “Like” us on Facebook! NEW SSD Page Published!

content.rendered:
Sherwood School District launched a new Facebook page with a new and improved design!  Be sure to CLICK HERE to visit and
“Like” the new page! We hope you’ll share the link with your
students and families to keep up to date on the latest news and information
from the District!
